newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to head for 4,630 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to head for 4,630 area.

text.p: Technical analysts expect a solid performance by the FTSE 100 index on Wednesday with a target set at 4,630.

The index had started to disintegrate this week on concerns the U.S. would raise interest rates but as that has not happened the FTSE can now retrace some of its losses starting with an early markup today.

Banks and pharmaceuticals which seemed unable to fight back recent losses may be able to stage a slight recovery as should the oils sector, although chemicals may not be so lively, they added. By 0707 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 5.4 at 4,612.9.

The FTSE had lost 86 points in the past two days sending it only slightly below trendline support at 4,610 but the seal of approval given by Wall Street last night means the FTSE can make reverse its course.

On Tuesday the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 74.58 at 7,303.46. But not only did the Dow perk up but so too did the transportation average which closed at a new high for the year -- up 11.05 at 911.72 -- implying a continuation of the bull trend in U.S. equities.
Short-term momentum indicators for the FTSE have unwound from overbought states and are approaching neutral levels.

This process should continue for a few days more but it will still allow the market to romp ahead without hindrance owing to the way these indicators are calculated which relies on taking values of the FTSE over a fixed time interval.

Indicators such as the 10 day mometum will therefore show the market slowing down but that's because it will have been calculated by values of the FTSE over the past 10 days in which the market had been slipping back.
As the FTSE keeps rising from now, the 10 day momentum will soon catch up and reflect that rise, analysts said.
